title: Assault on a custodial officer
summary: An unlawful attempt with present ability to apply violent force is required; actual contact or injury is not required. Assault on a custodial officer defined in section 831 or 831.5 while performing duties. The accused must know or reasonably be expected to know the specified status and performance of duties.
penalty: Felony alternative: 16 months, 2 years, or 3 years under section 1170(h); misdemeanor alternative: up to 364 days in county jail. Section 17 governs misdemeanor treatment. These are adult base penalties, not total sentence predictions. Restitution, assessments, enhancements and case-specific sentencing rules require separate review.
